TEXT:
I left the building and went straight for where 
Ayase was waiting, shaking my head.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...No good. They're all booked up.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I see...

Ayase looked up at the dark cloudy sky. It was 
raining heavily outside, accompanied with strong 
gusty winds.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Even the trains won't leave. They say the weather 
will get worse...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...We have to find somewhere to stay.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Yes.

Apparently, a typhoon was drawing near. And a 
pretty big one, meaning we would soon find 
ourselves in the middle of the storm.

Due to the weather conditions, all public 
transportation had stopped and as tourists flooded 
the hotels, they quickly ran out of rooms.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: But we still can't find somewhere to stay...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Actually, I asked around and there might just be a 
place. Want to take a look?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I couldn't get any confirmation, but checking it out 
is better than just standing here.

Besides, we're both going to catch a cold if we 
stand around here much longer.

After that, we managed to get a room to stay... Well, 
honestly I'm kind of worried whether this worn-out 
Japanese inn can stand against the strong winds.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: It's a good thing we found a vacant room, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It sure is.
We were both soaked to the bone.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...We'll catch a cold like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I guess. We should take a bath before that 
happens...

The rain and wind were still loud outside the 
windows. The news had said the storm would pass 
during the evening, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: It doesn't seem to be calming down...

Ayase was sitting next to me, smiling awkwardly. I 
was probably also stuck with a pretty awkward 
expression.

What was supposed to have been a day trip had 
now turned into a trip over a day and a night. It's 
pretty natural to be nervous here...
Still, Ayase is really cute in a yukata. Seriously.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It'd be nice if the typhoon passes quickly.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I-It would.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
And it seems the train isn't back up and running yet 
either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Ah! It's rare that we're at a Japanese inn, we just 
have to eat some steamed buns!

Maybe she couldn't take any more of this awkward 
conversation, since she spoke up in a conspicuously 
bright voice.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah, this is surprisingly good!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I guess I'll have one too.

Going with the flow, I took a steamed bun... Huh? 
Doesn't this taste kind of strange?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
That reminds me, the bath was pretty big, wasn't 
it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I guess it was. Though it was still pretty worn-out.

Ayase was quickly stuffing her mouth with the 
steamed buns. I guess she's still a bit nervous.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Still, it feels good to be able to stretch your legs in 
the bath.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
And since there weren't any other guests, it was as 
if we reserved the entire bath.

Ayase's body suddenly started to sway for a 
moment.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: H-Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, are you okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Y-Yes... It's nothing...

Ayase smiled as she replied... and her head fell on 
my shoulder.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Um, Onii-san...
Her eyes were half-closed.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Can you... hold my hand?
Her face was completely flushed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Sure, I don't mind...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
I'm feeling all hot... It just has to be your fault, 
Onii-san.
Even her yukata was worn-out...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Onii-san, your heart is also beating really fast, isn't it? 
I can feel it through your hand...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Want to... check my pulse...

W-Wait! ...Does she mean... that?! My body is not 
ready...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey, let's stop joking around now.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Hey, aren't you going to check...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san...

Her breath was brushing against my face. Her 
clouded eyes took a hold of my confused heart.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Ayase!

I made up my mind and turned to look into her 
eyes...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Ayase?

Ayase had fallen asleep with her head on my 
shoulder with an intoxicated expression on her face.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ayase? Ayase-san~? ...She's sound asleep?

Suddenly curious, I checked the wrapping paper 
on the remaining buns.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sake buns...? So thanks to these, Ayase...

I suddenly felt all my energy drain from my body. 
Haha, yeah, that's it...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: G-Good morning...

The next morning, Ayase was back to normal... No 
actually, she might be even more nervous now than 
yesterday.

She seems to remember some parts of last night, 
but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Looks like the typhoon has passed.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Y-Yes, it has.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Let's go home, shall we?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Um, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: N-No, it's nothing...

Even after we got back, there was this 
awkwardness between us.

On the other hand, Ayase had been so erotic last 
night...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Okay, I'm going this way, so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll walk you home.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: No... I'm fine from here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Alright. Be careful on your way home.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: You too, Onii-san... I'll call you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sure.

I stood there looking after her until she 
disappeared from my view.
And so the curtains closed on our first trip together.
